identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][providers] Scope MiniMax billing classification to MiniMax responses

values.summary: Implemented MiniMax-scoped billing classification for code 1008 and cross-provider regressions.
actual_changes: Refactored MiniMax base_resp error classification into a reusable MiniMax-only helper.
Parse MiniMax non-success HTTP base_resp envelopes before falling back to shared HTTP classification.
Removed the shared bare 1008 substring billing shortcut.
Added positive MiniMax and negative OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic hosted provider regressions.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove MiniMax status_code 1008 remains non-retryable ProviderBillingBlocked.
Prove non-MiniMax hosted providers do not inherit MiniMax billing classification from bare 1008 text.
Prove the provider adapter changes are warning-clean under strict Clippy.
